name: WannaCry
note: The May outbreak's encryptor. Look for file enumeration, CryptoAPI calls and embedded resources.

name: NotPetya
note: Look for disk access, credential handling and network propagation in the June attack's DLL.

name: Stuxnet driver
note: A small driver from the Stuxnet toolkit. Explore kernel imports and driver initialization.

name: Mirai
note: A compact, statically linked bot. Explore Linux system calls and XOR encoding in the decompiled code.

name: 3CX backdoor
note: A small payload from the 3CX attack. Explore Objective-C message sends and macOS imports.

name: RustBucket Swift loader
note: The campaign's Swift loader on Apple silicon. Search GetOSVersion to explore Swift and Objective-C calls.

name: Industroyer2
note: A compact industrial control payload. Look for IEC-104 protocol handling and embedded configuration.

name: NimBlackout
note: Explore Nim runtime functions and names preserved in the compiler's COFF symbol table.

name: Cloud Snooper
note: Built with debug information. Explore source function names, parameter names and recovered types.
